tasks.note: The main operating assumptions now take priority over payment-timing refinements. Independent read-only evidence review found that the central case needs stronger joint driver and cash support; no replacement company assumptions are adopted. The standing generic-analysis boundary is recorded in AGENTS.md and adopted decisions: shared financial changes need a reusable analytical benefit, while issuer-specific forecast corrections stay in the company analysis. Policy/proposal updates require compatible history, an evidence bridge for material departures and a sensitivity addressing the main dependency, without a historical-peak ceiling. Independent documentation review passed. The 10% starting hurdle, 9% sensitivity and historical SIXRX distinction remain adopted. Existing formulas and saved analyses are unchanged; the remaining implementation is still proposed. User clarified that supported financial assumptions may be defended: a challenge triggers reassessment, while the report explains the evidence, business mechanism and selected magnitude beside each material forecast. The compact reader edition is implemented separately. The next evidence priority is a supportable operating-to-capital-and-cash bridge: joint forecast drivers, incremental capital needs and cash retained after all distributions. Matched peers and ownership/claim evidence remain explicit limits. Reuse the simple existing formulas; do not tune shared logic to the worked example. Cross-company audit found materially different price-relative targets, per-panel chart autoscaling, repeated probability precision without an evidence-to-number bridge, and selected exit multiples tied to current market pricing. All thirty saved scenario outputs and adopted weighted returns reproduce from their inputs; this verifies consistency, not forecast truth. Company-specific risk rationales exist and no fixed default was found. Proposed generic improvements are price-relative comparisons, explicit multiple provenance and a compact outcome/evidence/uncertainty note with an alternative-weight hurdle check. Existing analyses and policies remain preserved; the user chose scenario returns first, with weights and weighted returns secondary. Exact comparisons and primary-source citations are kept privately. Skill-structure assessment recommends two concise role entrypoints, company analysis and independent valuation challenge, sharing the existing canonical policy and formula definitions. The current runner sends text only and packet contract accepts policy/calculations only; explicit delivery and a compatible frozen role-skill identity are needed before adoption. This is a proposal, not an installed skill or a change to financial methods. A small cross-company behavior check should test probability justification, multiple provenance and readable decision evidence.
